## About
Elite Auto Werks Collision Center is a collision repair shop on Skillman Street in Dallas. We repair the damage, and we also do wheel alignments and wheel repair.
We know an accident can throw off your whole week. Our goal is to take some of that stress off you with careful repairs, honest answers and a free quote before any work begins.
We hold a 4.9 rating from 457 Google reviews. One customer said his car looked better than it did before, and another said hers came out looking brand new as if nothing happened.

## Services
- Elite Auto Werks Collision Center: Collision repair that restores your vehicle to its pre-accident condition, with careful workmanship and a team that keeps you informed.
- Wheel Alignments: Alignment work for better handling, longer tire life and overall safety, done with state-of-the-art equipment.
- Wheel Repair: When a curb or pothole gets the better of a wheel, we restore how it rolls and how it looks.
- Hail damage repair: One customer brought his car to us for hail damage and said the repair went past what he expected.

## FAQ
Q: Is the estimate free?
A: Yes. Reach out to schedule an appointment or to get your free quote, and we'll walk you through what your car needs.

Q: Do you work with insurance claims?
A: Yes. One customer has brought his cars to us for insurance claims repairs, and another chose us because we are a preferred shop with her insurance company. Call us to ask about your insurer.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we're open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
